title: Access Percentage Settings and Program Change Allowances by Tier
content:
Under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement the employer configures the access percentage its workers may draw and may submit program changes within the allowances of its program tier.

| | Starter | Growth | Professional | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Highest access percentage the employer may configure (percent) | 50 | 50 | 50 | 60 | 60 | 70 |
| Lowest access percentage the employer may configure (percent) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Configured access percentages must be a multiple of (percent) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Access percentage set at contract when the employer configures none (percent) | 40 | 40 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Access percentage changes allowed in any rolling 365 days | 2 | 2 | 4 | 4 | 6 | 6 |
| Fee model changes allowed in any rolling 365 days | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Business days after a change request is submitted before the first pay period it can take effect in may begin | 5 | 5 | 5 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Consecutive monthly censuses outside the tier's headcount band after which the program moves to the matching tier | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |

**Requesters.** On every tier the employer portal roles allowed to submit program changes and termination notices are the program owner and the payroll admin.

## Points of judgement

- A configured access percentage is valid on a tier only where it lies between that tier's lowest and highest figure and is a multiple of 5. On the Paystride Program Enterprise tier, for example, 55 percent is a valid setting and 65 percent is not; on the Strategic tier 65 percent is valid.
- The change allowances count changes within any rolling 365 days; on the Professional tier an employer may have up to four access percentage changes and one fee model change in such a period.
- The lead time is counted in business days after the submission date of the change request.
